liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1981-04-30.134544.aud.wise.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd81-04-30.aud.cribbs.5057.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry performs lofty solos while the crowd responds enthusiastically [11]
- **gd1981-04-30.sbd.miller.91728.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 3.92/5 by 12 [5]. Said about its sound: Second set features creative solo improv work from Brent and Jerry [15]
- **gd1981-04-30.175090.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min [6]
- **gd1981-04-30.147854.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 159 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]

## Around the show

- Girls dancing in entrance ways, silhouetted by outside light, during this performance [10]
- Listener describes the performance as spectacular and full of gold [12]
- Bob introduces song referencing a local train wreck and dead engineer [17]
- Performance described as lackluster, possibly due to jet lag, with fast pacing [13]
- Song played quickly as the night was coming to an end [13]
- Listener disagrees with lackluster assessment, calling the show energetic and tight [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-04-30.134544.aud.wise.flac24**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Cassette Audience Master recorded By Jim Wise; Set 1 Beyerdynamic M160 Double Ribbon Hypercardiod microphones mounted on a stand-Sony TC D-5 Cassette Recorder;… [1]
- **gd81-04-30.aud.cribbs.5057.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording [2]
- **gd1981-04-30.sbd.miller.91728.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Reel -> Dat (48k) D [5]
- **gd1981-04-30.175090.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Reel > DAT (48k) [6]. Also: Vocal phase repair applied to It Must Have Been The Roses [6]
- **gd1981-04-30.147854.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (12th row)> Sony D5M [7]
